claims.title: Endpoint-only signed microscopic response and finite intervention decisions

quoted_fields.interface: The producer constructs and executes microscopic rate-intervention response and finite-strength counterfactual expectation calculations using an unchanged stochastic simulator, native endpoint calls and complete restorable checkpoints. A signed generator action closes a certified finite-improvement decision without exposing rates, events, derivatives or a parameter-change operation. This is a completed mathematical and computational capability for the declared simulator class; it does not establish physical cloning, reset, a laboratory rate actuator or a civilisation-changing application.
quoted_fields.failure: The global R may grow with system size. The response scale R^2 T^2 and exponential finite-strength variance can make long or strong interventions expensive. Checkpoint copying, arithmetic, storage, physical evolution duration and rare-event relative precision remain resources. Endpoint laws identify aggregate state-transition rates, not selectively hidden mechanisms sharing a transition. Multiplicative edits cannot invent an absent reaction. A physical material change need not obey the specified edge multipliers. Positive sampling of native jumps is obstructed in the general class; the theorem does not rule out every positive sampler of perturbed positive-time endpoints.
